targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(st.download_speed_mbps) as value FROM speed_tests st JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp) AND st.download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    download_speed_mbps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY download_speed_mbps) AS row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      st.download_speed_mbps
    FROM speed_tests st
    JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
      AND st.download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      AND p.location IN ($location)
      AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)
  ) d
)
SELECT
  AVG(download_speed_mbps) AS median
FROM ranked
WHERE row_num IN (
  (total_count + 1) / 2,
  (total_count + 2) / 2
);

SELECT AVG(st.upload_speed_mbps) as value FROM speed_tests st JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp) AND st.upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    upload_speed_mbps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY upload_speed_mbps) AS row_num,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      st.upload_speed_mbps
    FROM speed_tests st
    JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
      AND st.upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      AND p.location IN ($location)
      AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)
  ) d
)
SELECT
  AVG(upload_speed_mbps) AS value
FROM ranked
WHERE row_num IN (
  (total_count + 1) / 2,
  (total_count + 2) / 2
);

SELECT
  st.timestamp as time_sec,
  AVG(st.download_speed_mbps) as avg_download
FROM speed_tests st
JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
  AND st.download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
  AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  st.timestamp as time_sec,
  AVG(st.upload_speed_mbps) as avg_upload
FROM speed_tests st
JOIN proxies p ON st.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
  AND st.upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
  AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

WITH ProxyStats AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(download_speed_mbps) AS avg_download,
      MIN(download_speed_mbps) AS min_download,
      MAX(download_speed_mbps) AS max_download,
      AVG(upload_speed_mbps) AS avg_upload,
      MIN(upload_speed_mbps) AS min_upload,
      MAX(upload_speed_mbps) AS max_upload,
      MAX(timestamp) AS last_test,
      COUNT(*) AS test_count
    FROM speed_tests
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),

MedianDL AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(download_speed_mbps) AS median_download
    FROM (
      SELECT
        proxy_id,
        download_speed_mbps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY proxy_id
          ORDER BY download_speed_mbps
        ) AS row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY proxy_id) AS total_count
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          proxy_id,
          download_speed_mbps
        FROM speed_tests
        WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
          AND download_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      ) d
    ) t
    WHERE row_num IN (
      (total_count + 1) / 2,
      (total_count + 2) / 2
    )
    GROUP BY proxy_id
),

MedianUL AS (
    SELECT
      proxy_id,
      AVG(upload_speed_mbps) AS median_upload
    FROM (
      SELECT
        proxy_id,
        upload_speed_mbps,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY proxy_id
          ORDER BY upload_speed_mbps
        ) AS row_num,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY proxy_id) AS total_count
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          proxy_id,
          upload_speed_mbps
        FROM speed_tests
        WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
          AND upload_speed_mbps IS NOT NULL
      ) d
    ) t
    WHERE row_num IN (
      (total_count + 1) / 2,
      (total_count + 2) / 2
    )
    GROUP BY proxy_id
)

SELECT
  p.name,
  p.device_id,
  p.location,
  p.version,
  ps.last_test,
  ps.avg_download,
  md.median_download,
  ps.min_download,
  ps.max_download,
  ps.avg_upload,
  mu.median_upload,
  ps.min_upload,
  ps.max_upload,
  ps.test_count
FROM proxies p
LEFT JOIN ProxyStats ps ON p.device_id = ps.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN MedianDL md ON p.device_id = md.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN MedianUL mu ON p.device_id = mu.proxy_id
WHERE p.location IN ($location)
  AND p.device_id IN ($proxy)
ORDER BY ps.avg_download DESC;
